newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends little changed vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends little changed vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed little changed at 8.2906 on Friday from Thursday's 8.2907 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai and trading was dull, dealers said.
The weighted average price on Thursday was 8.2908.
Dealers said after the yuan failed to breach the 8.2900 level on Thursday, buying was seen more cautious on Friday.
The yuan opened up at an intraday high of 8.2904 and consolidated in a narrow range of 8.2904/8.2907 for most of the session, hitting a low of 8.2908.
"The yuan's movement has been very stable with a wait-and-see mood prevailing ahead of the weekend," one dealer said.
"With the yuan failing to breach the key resistance level of 8.2900, investors had few incentives to test it again today," he said.
Buying has pushed the local currency to test the 8.2900 level several times recently, but it was unbreakable, dealers said.
They said they expected the yuan to move around the 8.2910 level early next week.
The yuan closed up at 7.1005 from 7.1800 against 100 Japanese yen and up at an intraday high of 1.0700 from 1.0705 against the Hong Kong dollar.
